title: CSCI 622 — Data Security and Privacy
subject: Cybersecurity
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define and explain the core principles of data confidentiality, integrity, and privacy in enterprise and personal data contexts.
Apply the Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) practice groups to identify and mitigate security risks in software development.
Evaluate cryptographic standards and secure database architectures to ensure proper data protection and compliance with legal/ethical guidelines.
